phishingWarning.title: Phishing and impersonation warning
phishingWarning.opening: Please remain vigilant against phishing, fraudulent communications, and impersonation when you take part in the Metropolis Hackathon.
phishingWarning.impersonation: Third parties may use the names, logos, or branding of Monad, the hackathon, or participating organizations to create the appearance of an official affiliation. This applies to emails, direct messages, social media accounts, websites, GitHub repositories, and software or scripts.

credentials.title: Protect your credentials
credentials.detail: The hackathon team will never request your wallet's private key or seed phrase. Do not disclose these credentials to anyone claiming to provide registration, verification, deployment assistance, technical support, or prize distribution.

verify.title: Verify communications independently
verify.detail: Confirm unexpected requests through the official hackathon website or an established organizer contact. Do not rely on links or contact details supplied in the message you are attempting to verify.

software.title: Exercise caution with software and wallet requests
software.detail: Do not run unfamiliar code, enter wallet credentials into unverified tools, or approve transactions or signatures you do not understand. A request presented as a routine setup or deployment step should receive the same scrutiny.

pressure.title: Resist pressure to act immediately
pressure.detail: Claims of urgency, eligibility deadlines, or potential loss of a prize should not replace independent verification.

preserve.title: Preserve relevant account names, URLs, and messages
preserve.detail: Exclude private keys, seed phrases, passwords, and other sensitive information from any materials you share.

phishingWarning.closing: This notice is a general security reminder for all participants. Please continue to take care when you interact with third parties throughout the hackathon.

danger.title: Delete account
danger.deleteBody: Request permanent deletion of your account and personal data. You'll leave your team when the request begins. The team will keep the project, and your name will be removed from any work you published.
danger.confirmBody: Your account becomes unavailable, and you leave your team immediately. The team remains when active members remain. The team dissolves when you are the final member. Permanent deletion starts after the server-configured grace period. Cancelling deletion restores your account, but it does not restore team membership.
danger.heldTitle: Your deletion request is under review
danger.heldBody: We will contact you after the review. If you had a team, your membership ended when you sent the request. The team keeps the work you contributed to, and your name comes off it when the deletion completes.
danger.scheduledBody: Permanent deletion starts on {date}. You cannot undo it after that time. If you had a team, your membership ended when you sent the request. The team keeps the project, the updates, and the submissions you contributed to, because that record belongs to every member. Your name comes off each one when the deletion completes.
